sceptical_outlets.headline: Bizarre petition for Argentina to be BANNED from World Cup inexplicably ignored by FIFA
sceptical_outlets.what_they_questioned: Named ArgentinaOut.org. Warned against visiting ('aggressive advert redirects'). Called petition a 'dumb stunt'. Said 'we're sceptical' about whether signatures are legitimate. Noted the site generates ad revenue.
sceptical_outlets.tone: Sarcastic/dismissive rather than investigative. Scepticism was editorial voice, not reported verification.
sceptical_outlets.notes: Only mainstream sports outlet to express any doubt.

sceptical_outlets.headline: Millions Back Petitions to Ban Argentina over 'Rigged' World Cup Run
sceptical_outlets.what_they_questioned: Stated: 'no independent audit has been published, no organizers have been identified or provided contact details, and several basic transparency standards expected of a legitimate petition are absent.' Named argentinaout.com and argentina-out.org. Noted the existence of an 'almost identical version' showing 28M.
sceptical_outlets.tone: Substantive and specific. The most forensic questioning of any outlet found.
sceptical_outlets.notes: Author: Joakim Scheffer. Also cited Euronews and Guinness benchmarks. The only outlet to note multiple versions of the site.
